title: A Video Call with Grandpa in Canada
passage:
Last Sunday evening, Tina was sitting in the living room, waiting for her weekly video call with Grandpa, who moved to Canada last year.
"Hi, Tina! Can you hear me clearly?" Grandpa asked, waving at the screen.
"Yes, Grandpa! You look great today," Tina said happily.
"It's much colder here than in Taiwan," Grandpa said, pointing out the window. "The snow is falling outside right now."
"Wow, it's as hot as summer here!" Tina laughed. "What are you doing these days?"
"I'm learning to cook Canadian dishes, and I'm also planting flowers in the garden," Grandpa said proudly.
"That sounds more exciting than staying at home!" Tina replied. "When are you going to visit us?"
"I'm going to fly back next winter," Grandpa said. "I miss your mom's cooking so much."
"We miss you too!" Tina said. "Mom is cooking dinner right now. Do you want to say hello to her?"
"Of course! Please pass the phone to her," Grandpa said with a smile.
Tina ran to the kitchen, holding the phone carefully. "Mom, Grandpa wants to talk to you!"
Her mother wiped her hands quickly and took the phone. The whole family felt warm and connected, even though they were far apart.

grammar: 現在進行時 (Present continuous)：be + V-ing，表示當下正在進行的動作，如 The snow is falling outside right now. / Mom is cooking dinner right now.

比較級 (Comparatives)：形容詞加 -er + than 或 more + 形容詞 + than 表示「比...更」；as + 形容詞 + as 表示「和...一樣」，如 It's much colder here than in Taiwan. / That sounds more exciting than staying at home! / It's as hot as summer here!
be going to 表未來計畫：be + going to + 原形動詞，用於談論已決定的未來計畫，如 I'm going to fly back next winter. / When are you going to visit us?

reading.q: Why was Tina waiting in the living room on Sunday evening?
opts: To watch a movie with her mom
To have her weekly video call with Grandpa
reading.ex: 文中提到 Tina 在客廳等待她每週與爺爺的視訊電話（weekly video call）。

reading.q: What is the weather like in Canada according to Grandpa?
opts: It is much colder and snowing
It is as hot as summer
reading.ex: Grandpa 說「It's much colder here than in Taiwan... The snow is falling outside right now.」

reading.q: What is Grandpa doing in Canada these days?
opts: Learning to cook Canadian dishes and planting flowers
reading.ex: Grandpa 提到他正在學做加拿大菜，也在花園種花。

reading.q: When does Grandpa plan to visit Taiwan?
opts: He is not planning to visit
reading.ex: Grandpa 說「I'm going to fly back next winter.」

reading.q: What did Tina do after Grandpa asked to talk to her mom?
opts: She ran to the kitchen holding the phone carefully
She asked Grandpa to call again later
reading.ex: 文中提到 Tina 小心地拿著電話跑到廚房找媽媽。

grammar.q: Choose the sentence that correctly uses present continuous for an action happening right now.
opts: The snow falls outside right now.
The snow is falling outside right now.
The snow fell outside right now.
The snow falling outside right now.
grammar.ex: 現在進行時為 be + V-ing，描述當下正在發生的動作，故選 B。

grammar.q: Choose the correct comparative sentence meaning Canada is colder than Taiwan.
opts: It's much colder here than in Taiwan.
It's much cold here than in Taiwan.
It's much more colder here than in Taiwan.
It's much coldest here than in Taiwan.
grammar.ex: 比較級用「形容詞-er + than」，cold 的比較級是 colder，故選 A。

grammar.q: Choose the sentence that correctly uses "as...as" to show equal comparison.
opts: It's as hot than summer here.
It's as hot as summer here.
It's as hotter as summer here.
It's so hot as summer here.
grammar.ex: 「as + 形容詞原級 + as」表示「和...一樣」，故選 B。

grammar.q: Choose the correct sentence using "be going to" to talk about a future plan.
opts: Grandpa going to fly back next winter.
Grandpa is going to fly back next winter.
Grandpa is go to fly back next winter.
Grandpa was going fly back next winter.
grammar.ex: be going to 結構為 be + going to + 原形動詞，故選 B。

grammar.q: Choose the correct question using "be going to" to ask about a future plan.
opts: When you are going to visit us?
When are you going to visit us?
When do you going to visit us?
When going are you to visit us?
grammar.ex: 疑問句語序為 Wh- + be + 主詞 + going to + 原形動詞，故選 B。

vocab.ex: weekly 意為「每週的」，指每週固定進行的事。
proudly 意為「自豪地」，符合爺爺分享種花成果時的語氣。

vocab.q: What is the meaning of "miss" in "I miss your mom's cooking so much"?
vocab.ex: 此處 miss 意為「想念」，表示爺爺很想念媽媽做的菜。

vocab.q: Tina ran to the kitchen, holding the phone ______, meaning in a very cautious way.
vocab.ex: carefully 意為「小心地」，符合謹慎拿著手機的情境。

vocab.q: What does "connected" mean in "The whole family felt warm and connected"?
vocab.ex: connected 意為「連結的；有聯繫的」，指全家人即使分隔兩地仍感到彼此相連。
